name: GET /api/leadflow/credits/balance - can I afford this now
description:
The narrow question the workspace asks, kept separate from the budget-tier detail on /summary — pointing the screen at /summary would work and return a page it has no use for, and the first person to change that shape would break a screen that never wanted it.

NULL, NEVER ZERO, when the balance cannot be read. Zero means "you cannot afford this"; unknown means "we could not check" — and a screen that greys out an action for the wrong one of those sends somebody to find a workaround.

testCases.name: NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all
NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.message: Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer.

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify.
